Lemma
[a Jacobi field with prescribed data at an interior time]

↗ lem:dc-ch8-2-1-jacobi-backward-uniqueness ↗ def:dc-ch5-2-1

Let $\gamma $ be a geodesic on $[a,b]$, let $t_0\in [a,b]$, and let $J_0,DJ_0\in T_{\gamma (t_0)}M$. Then there is a Jacobi field $(J,DJ)$ on $[a,b]$ with $J(t_0)=J_0$ and $DJ(t_0)=DJ_0$.
Proof

\sketch Send initial data at $a$ to the resulting data at $t_0$. This linear map is injective by section 1, and its domain and codomain both have dimension $2n$. It is therefore surjective.

□
